purpose: Test the first mandatory source-preservation obligation left by v7.3: can its abstract rigid-orbit NEQ_3 pp gadget be embedded directly into the smooth-C4 Hamiltonian quotient? The answer is no for the natural three-component gadget, and more generally no pure path-composition gadget can realize NEQ_3 under even the weakest scalar C4 Hamiltonian incidence-capacity condition. This proves that the Hamiltonian port geometry is already doing nontrivial work and that abstract pp completeness cannot simply be promoted to a source-preserving hardness statement.

source_capacity.C4_node: A complementary smooth C4 contains four original graph vertices. Each vertex has exactly two Hamiltonian neighbours, so after contracting the C4 the quotient node has exactly eight Hamiltonian half-edges, two incident at each labelled port.
source_capacity.bundle_cost: A bundle B of k Hamiltonian cross-edges consumes k quotient half-edges at each of its two endpoint components. Therefore any component incident with bundles of cardinalities k1,...,kt must satisfy sum ki <= 8. Port-by-port degree-two constraints are stronger; v7.4 deliberately uses only the weaker scalar inequality, so any impossibility proved here remains valid after restoring full port constraints.
source_capacity.minimum_relation_cost: For each of the 120 rigid orbit relations from v7.3, exhaust all valid labelled rigid bundles that realize it and record the minimum bundle cardinality. The profile is: one relation of cost 3, twenty-seven of cost 4, fifty-six of cost 5, twenty-six of cost 6, eight of cost 7, and two of cost 8.

v7_3_certificate_capacity_failure.certificate: v7.3 used NEQ_3 = A intersect (B composed C). Its displayed A,B,C bundles have cardinalities 4,6,6.
v7_3_certificate_capacity_failure.component_loads: The three-variable factor triangle has loads x:4+6=10, y:4+6=10, z:6+6=12, all exceeding the C4 capacity 8.
v7_3_certificate_capacity_failure.stronger_exhaustive_statement: The checker does not merely inspect that one representation. Over all 120 rigid relations, using the minimum possible bundle cost for each relation, there is no triple R,S,T such that R intersect (S composed T)=NEQ_3 and simultaneously cost(R)+cost(S)<=8, cost(R)+cost(T)<=8, and cost(S)+cost(T)<=8.
v7_3_certificate_capacity_failure.consequence: No direct three-C4 rigid-bundle realization of the one-auxiliary-variable pp shape R(x,y) AND exists z[S(x,z) AND T(z,y)] can implement NEQ_3, even before port labels, gain holonomy and exact 8-regular completion are enforced.

path_composition_obstruction.setup: Consider any path of rigid bundle atoms R1(x0,x1),...,Rk(x{k-1},xk), with each Ri realized at its minimum rigid bundle cost ci. A necessary scalar source condition at every internal C4 is ci+c{i+1}<=8. Eliminating the internal orbit variables gives relational composition R1 composed ... composed Rk.
path_composition_obstruction.finite_automaton_check: Track states (current composed binary relation, last atom cost) under all 120 rigid relation choices satisfying the adjacent-capacity inequality. No state with current relation NEQ_3 is reachable. The reachable state set stabilizes after path length four; its state-key set is identical at lengths 4 and 5 (and therefore under the same transition operator at every later length).
path_composition_obstruction.conclusion: No arbitrarily long pure series/path composition of rigid C4 orbit atoms can source-realize NEQ_3 while respecting even the scalar eight-half-edge capacity.

main_theorem.name: ABSTRACT_RIGID_PP_COMPLETENESS_DOES_NOT_DIRECTLY_EMBED_THROUGH_C4_PORT_CAPACITY
main_theorem.statement: The v7.3 abstract NEQ_3 pp certificate and every capacity-feasible three-atom certificate of the same shape fail to embed into three smooth C4 quotient nodes. Moreover NEQ_3 is unreachable by any capacity-feasible pure path composition of rigid orbit relations.
main_theorem.proof_scope: This is an exact finite/source-geometric obstruction, not a tractability theorem. It uses only relation masks and minimum rigid bundle cardinalities, hence is weaker than full port/gain/Euler consistency and cannot accidentally exclude a physically possible gadget because of an overly strong modelling assumption.

positive: Confirms that the source geometry flagged in v7.3 is substantive: C4 Hamiltonian half-edge conservation already blocks the shortest abstract hardness gadget.
Eliminates pure series composition as a route to rebuilding arbitrary NEQ_3 constraints inside the rigid quotient.
Focuses the next search on branching/cyclic gadgets, variable-copy mechanisms, exact port-degree conservation and holonomy rather than more abstract clone closure.
not_killed: A larger branching rigid gadget that respects eight half-edges at every C4 node.
A cyclic gadget using S3 holonomy constructively.
Variable splitting through a source-realizable equality/copy gadget.
A polynomial algorithm exploiting the same conservation law.
algorithmic_consequence.firewall: Do not infer tractability from this obstruction. Generic rigid-orbit CSP is still pp-complete as an abstract language; v7.4 only proves that two simplest families of pp wiring do not fit the smooth-C4 Hamiltonian incidence budget.

next_target.name: E8_RIGID_COPY_GADGET_OR_EIGHT_REGULAR_FACTOR_GRAPH_CLASSIFICATION_V7_5
next_target.directive: Search directly in the source geometry. Enumerate small connected factor graphs whose vertices are C4 components, whose rigid-bundle edge weights obey total incident weight exactly eight (and then full per-port degree exactly two), and whose existential orbit/gain relation between two terminals is EQ_3 or NEQ_3. Start with four to six C4 components and quotient cycles/branching graphs; enforce unique relative gains and global holonomy, not orbit relations alone. If no copy/NEQ gadget exists through a bounded size, extract a conserved invariant of the eight-regular port system rather than treating finite search failure as a theorem.
